title: Fail-closed offline bundle verification before unpack/install (exit codes + UX + logs)
author: Ethan Park
description:
Context: For air-gapped installs we ship an offline bundle (images + charts + binaries + manifest). We already have `installer offline verify` stubbed in #1042, but the install path still unpacked/loaded artifacts before verification.

This PR makes verification fail-closed *before* any unpack/install side effects when `installer offline install` (and the internal `offline apply`) is invoked with a bundle path.

Key changes: - Enforce signature + manifest checksum verification as the first step of offline install; abort before extracting archives, importing OCI images, or writing install state. - Add stable exit codes to allow SEs / automation to distinguish "bad signature" vs "manifest mismatch" vs "io/corruption". - Improve UX messages: high-signal errors with next-step hints (e.g., re-copy media, validate bundle path, collect diagnostics). - Add structured logging for verification outcomes (success/failure) with fields suitable for audit export; avoid logging secrets (no signature bytes, no raw manifest contents).

Behavior: - Default is fail-closed for offline bundle installs. - No break-glass override in this PR; will land separately behind explicit flag + acknowledgement prompt (ENG-3915).

Exit codes (new): - 20: signature invalid / could not be validated - 21: manifest digest mismatch / artifact digest mismatch - 22: unsupported bundle manifest version - 23: bundle unreadable (I/O) - 1: other errors

Test plan: - Unit tests for error mapping -> exit codes. - Added integration-ish tests for offline install path in `cmd/installer` using temp dirs with corrupted manifest/signature.

Rollout notes: - This tightens behavior for offline installs only. Online/VPC paths unaffected. - Docs in progress in redwood-docs; this PR keeps error strings stable so docs can reference them.

Refs: ENG-3914, ENG-3920. Follow-ups: ENG-3915 (break-glass), ENG-3917 (full hermetic air-gap CI).
commits: cmd/installer: gate offline install on verify result; return typed verification errors
logging: add verification event fields (bundle_id, release, manifest_version, outcome)
ux: rewrite user-facing error text; add 'next steps' hints
tests: add corrupted-manifest and bad-signature fixtures
conversation:
Marcus Lin (review): The ordering change looks right, but I want to be explicit: do we write *anything* to disk before verification now? In particular, do we create the workdir and/or cache paths?

Ethan Park (author): We still create the temp workdir directory (under the installer temp root) because we need a scratch location for reading the bundle archive metadata in a stream-safe way, but we do not extract any payloads and we do not write install state. I added a comment + ensured the workdir is removed on all failure paths.

Marcus Lin (review): OK. Please also ensure we don’t log any signature / manifest contents. I see `manifest_path` and `bundle_path` in logs; that’s fine. But avoid logging full error strings from underlying crypto libs if they include bytes.

Ethan Park (author): Good catch. I added `sanitizeVerifyErr(err)` that maps known verify errors to stable messages and strips the wrapped error chain from crypto libs. Unit test added.

Kevin Osei (review): For audit export, can we standardize fields? Please align with the structure we’ve been using elsewhere: `event_name`, `outcome`, `reason_code`, `bundle_id`, `release_version`, `commit_sha` (if present).

Ethan Park (author): Updated event payload to include `event_name=offline_bundle_verification`, `outcome`, `reason_code` (maps to exit code enum), plus optional `release_version` and `commit_sha` pulled from manifest if available. Added a small guard so missing fields don’t fail verification.

Benji Okafor (review): UX strings: can we make it very clear that this is an integrity check and that install won’t proceed? Also consider users who are running with `--quiet`.

Ethan Park (author): Updated copy to: "Integrity verification failed; installation will not continue." For `--quiet`, we still print one-line error + exit code; logs carry details.

Priya Natarajan (review): Do we have a path for older bundles (no signature yet) in staging? We’ll break internal testing.

Ethan Park (author): For now, offline install requires signed bundles; staging bundles from release pipeline will be signed as part of the rollout sequence. For local dev, there’s a `--allow-unsigned-test-bundles` internal-only build tag in #1042 that still works for CI fixtures; not exposed in production builds. I added a note in the docs file.

Marcus Lin (review): Please add a distinct exit code for unsupported manifest version to help field debugging.

Ethan Park (author): Added exit code 22 for unsupported manifest version and updated mapping + tests.

Marcus Lin (review): Approved after last changes.

Kevin Osei (review): Approved.

Benji Okafor (review): Approved.

Merge: Squash merge by Ethan Park after CI green.

release_notes:
- Private installer now verifies signed offline bundles *before* unpack/install and fails closed on verification failure.
- Added stable exit codes for offline verification failures to improve automation and support triage.
- Improved user-facing errors and added structured audit-friendly verification logs.
